exposure: delivery status relative to ICU admission and criticality (no-delivery, postpartum, delivery-critical, delivery-non-critical)
SpO2 to fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) ratio (S/F ratio)
partial pressure of arterial oxygen to FiO2 ratio (P/F ratio)
outcome: maternal outcome (no invasive positive pressure ventilation [IPPV], use of IPPV, use of extracorporeal membrane oxygenation [ECMO], or death)
cohort: The study included all pregnant women admitted to an ICU in Israel with severe COVID-19 pneumonitis from the 13th week of gestation to the 1st week postpartum.
finding: Maternal outcome deteriorated following delivery for critically ill patients in the ICU, whereas non-critical patients improved after delivery, suggesting that interventional delivery should be considered for maternal indications before patient deterioration and the need for mechanical ventilation.
gest_age: 13th week of gestation to 1st week postpartum (inclusion criteria)
